answer: Mach and QNX are well-known examples of Microkernel-based operating systems.
Windows NT and Mac OS X (XNU Kernel) are examples of Hybrid Kernel operating systems.

A Simple OS often refers to early systems without multitasking or advanced features, whereas a Monolithic Kernel refers to the architectural design where all core OS functions run in the kernel space, supporting multitasking and advanced features.
